prompt.en: Which word means a job you feel called to do from the heart: 'vocation' or 'occupation'?
prompt.hi: Dil se kiya hua kaam, jaise ek bulawa — 'vocation' ya 'occupation'?

prompt.en: Read this poem: 'Nine runners crouched along the line, / the crowd a roar, the sun a flame; / the whistle blew, and all was fine / until the smallest stumbled, lame. // One turned. Then two. Then all the rest / ran back to help him stand once more; / they crossed the line together, pressed / in one long hug, and the stadium roared.' How many runners were in the race?

challenges.hint: It is the very first word of the poem.

prompt.en: Read: 'Anjali failed her first state-level swimming trial by four seconds. She cried in the bus all the way home. The next morning her coach was at the pool at five. "If you train like this every day for a year," he said, "you will cut those four seconds." She did not give up. Some mornings the water was so cold that her hands went numb; some evenings she wanted to quit. She kept a notebook and wrote down her time after every practice, even on bad days. A year later, she qualified by half a second. "The medal was nice," she says now, "but the notebook is what I keep."' By how many seconds did Anjali fail her first trial?
prompt.hi: Anjali pehle trial mein kitne seconds se reh gayi?
